support_case_opener_check.name: support_case_opener_check
support_case_opener_check.value: "support_case"."opened_by" is not null or "support_case"."organization_id" is null

agent_knowledge_entry_validity_check.name: agent_knowledge_entry_validity_check
agent_knowledge_entry_validity_check.value: "agent_knowledge_entry"."valid_from" is null or "agent_knowledge_entry"."valid_until" is null or "agent_knowledge_entry"."valid_until" >= "agent_knowledge_entry"."valid_from"

clinical_order_cancel_check.name: clinical_order_cancel_check
clinical_order_cancel_check.value: ("clinical_order"."cancelled_at" IS NULL) = ("clinical_order"."cancel_reason" IS NULL) AND ("clinical_order"."cancelled_at" IS NULL OR "clinical_order"."status" = 'cancelado') AND ("clinical_order"."cancel_reason" IS NULL OR char_length("clinical_order"."cancel_reason") BETWEEN 1 AND 2000)

consent_document_paper_check.name: consent_document_paper_check
consent_document_paper_check.value: CASE WHEN "consent_document"."signature_method" = 'papel' THEN "consent_document"."paper_document_id" IS NOT NULL ELSE "consent_document"."paper_document_id" IS NULL END

professional_profile_lengths_check.name: professional_profile_lengths_check
professional_profile_lengths_check.value: length("professional_profile"."professional_title") between 1 and 120 and length("professional_profile"."registration_body") between 1 and 40 and ("professional_profile"."registration_number" is null or length("professional_profile"."registration_number") between 1 and 20) and ("professional_profile"."signature_name" is null or length("professional_profile"."signature_name") between 1 and 200) and ("professional_profile"."specialty_registration" is null or length("professional_profile"."specialty_registration") between 1 and 40)

encounter_appointment_active_uidx.name: encounter_appointment_active_uidx
encounter_appointment_active_uidx.where: appointment_id IS NOT NULL AND status <> 'anulada'

encounter_void_check.name: encounter_void_check
encounter_void_check.value: ("encounter"."status" = 'anulada') = ("encounter"."voided_at" IS NOT NULL) AND ("encounter"."voided_at" IS NULL) = ("encounter"."void_reason" IS NULL)

encounter_diagnosis_type_check.name: encounter_diagnosis_type_check
encounter_diagnosis_type_check.value: ("encounter_diagnosis"."diagnosis_type" IS NULL AND "encounter_diagnosis"."legacy_note_id" IS NOT NULL) OR "encounter_diagnosis"."diagnosis_type" IN ('provisional','confirmed')

encounter_diagnosis_origin_check.name: encounter_diagnosis_origin_check
encounter_diagnosis_origin_check.value: "encounter_diagnosis"."encounter_id" IS NOT NULL OR "encounter_diagnosis"."legacy_note_id" IS NOT NULL

patient_insurance_scheme_check.name: patient_insurance_scheme_check
patient_insurance_scheme_check.value: "patient"."insurance_scheme" IS NULL OR ("patient"."insurance_type" IS NOT NULL AND char_length("patient"."insurance_scheme") BETWEEN 1 AND 20)

patient_address_lengths_check.name: patient_address_lengths_check
patient_address_lengths_check.value: ("patient"."address_city" IS NULL OR char_length("patient"."address_city") BETWEEN 1 AND 100) AND ("patient"."address_district" IS NULL OR char_length("patient"."address_district") BETWEEN 1 AND 100) AND ("patient"."address_region" IS NULL OR char_length("patient"."address_region") BETWEEN 1 AND 100) AND ("patient"."address_postal_code" IS NULL OR char_length("patient"."address_postal_code") BETWEEN 1 AND 20) AND ("patient"."birth_place" IS NULL OR char_length("patient"."birth_place") BETWEEN 1 AND 200)

patient_document_image_type_check.name: patient_document_image_type_check
patient_document_image_type_check.value: "patient_document"."image_type" IS NULL OR ("patient_document"."category" = 'radiografia' AND "patient_document"."image_type" IN ('periapical','bitewing','oclusal','panoramica','cefalometrica','tomografia')) OR ("patient_document"."category" = 'foto_clinica' AND "patient_document"."image_type" IN ('foto_intraoral','foto_extraoral'))

patient_document_source_check.name: patient_document_source_check
patient_document_source_check.value: "patient_document"."source" IS NULL OR char_length("patient_document"."source") BETWEEN 1 AND 120

patient_document_retired_check.name: patient_document_retired_check
patient_document_retired_check.value: ("patient_document"."retired_at" IS NULL) = ("patient_document"."retire_reason" IS NULL) AND ("patient_document"."retire_reason" IS NULL OR char_length("patient_document"."retire_reason") BETWEEN 1 AND 2000)

agent_config_active_hours_check.name: agent_config_active_hours_check
agent_config_active_hours_check.value: ("agent_config"."active_from_min" is null) = ("agent_config"."active_until_min" is null) and ("agent_config"."active_from_min" is null or ("agent_config"."active_from_min" between 0 and 1439 and "agent_config"."active_until_min" between 1 and 1440 and "agent_config"."active_from_min" <> "agent_config"."active_until_min"))

clinic_message_catalog_check.name: clinic_message_catalog_check
clinic_message_catalog_check.value: "clinic_message"."key" is null or ("clinic_message"."button_title" is null and "clinic_message"."archived_at" is null)

contact_screen_check.name: contact_screen_check
contact_screen_check.value:
("contact"."screen" IS NULL AND "contact"."screened_at" IS NULL AND "contact"."screened_by_user_id" IS NULL
        AND "contact"."screen_reason" IS NULL AND "contact"."screen_note" IS NULL)
      OR ("contact"."screen" = 'spam' AND "contact"."screened_at" IS NOT NULL
        AND "contact"."screen_reason" IN ('repeticion','publicidad','estafa','cadena','respuesta_automatica','venta','equipo'))
      OR ("contact"."screen" = 'blocked' AND "contact"."screened_at" IS NOT NULL AND "contact"."screened_by_user_id" IS NOT NULL
        AND "contact"."screen_reason" IN ('acoso','amenazas','estafa','otro') AND length(trim("contact"."screen_note")) > 0)

conversation_closed_coherence_check.name: conversation_closed_coherence_check
conversation_closed_coherence_check.value:
("conversation"."status" = 'open' and "conversation"."closed_at" is null and "conversation"."close_reason" is null and "conversation"."closed_by_user_id" is null)
        or ("conversation"."status" = 'closed' and "conversation"."closed_at" is not null and "conversation"."close_reason" is not null)

task_relationship_kind_check.name: task_relationship_kind_check
task_relationship_kind_check.value: ("task"."relationship_detail" IS NULL AND "task"."kinship" IS NULL) OR "task"."kind" = 'confirmar_representante'

cash_movement_payment_uidx.name: cash_movement_payment_uidx
cash_movement_payment_uidx.where: "cash_movement"."patient_payment_id" IS NOT NULL AND "cash_movement"."voided_at" IS NULL

ticket_footer.name: ticket_footer
ticket_footer.default: 'Recibo interno. No es un documento fiscal.'

saas_action_price_check.name: saas_action_price_check
saas_action_price_check.value: ("saas_action"."base_price_micros" IS NULL) = ("saas_action"."price_micros" IS NULL) AND coalesce("saas_action"."price_micros", 0) >= 0 AND "saas_action"."discount_bps" BETWEEN 0 AND 9000

saas_charge_line_amount_check.name: saas_charge_line_amount_check
saas_charge_line_amount_check.value: "saas_charge_line"."quantity" >= 0 AND CASE WHEN "saas_charge_line"."kind" = 'devolucion' THEN "saas_charge_line"."amount_cents" <= 0 ELSE "saas_charge_line"."amount_cents" >= 0 END

saas_plan_limits_check.name: saas_plan_limits_check
saas_plan_limits_check.value: ("saas_plan"."max_branches" IS NULL OR "saas_plan"."max_branches" > 0) AND ("saas_plan"."max_seats" IS NULL OR "saas_plan"."max_seats" > 0)

saas_subscription_terms_check.name: saas_subscription_terms_check
saas_subscription_terms_check.value: ("saas_subscription"."trial_credit_cents" IS NULL OR "saas_subscription"."trial_credit_cents" >= 0) AND ("saas_subscription"."trial_days" IS NULL OR "saas_subscription"."trial_days" BETWEEN 1 AND 365) AND ("saas_subscription"."spend_cap_cents" IS NULL OR "saas_subscription"."spend_cap_cents" >= 0) AND "saas_subscription"."billing_cycle" IN ('mensual','quincenal')
